name: Triple Alliance (Tenochtitlan, Texcoco, Tlacopan — "Aztec Empire")
notes: Founded 1428 when Tenochtitlan, Texcoco, and Tlacopan allied to overthrow the Tepanec capital Azcapotzalco (Pedro Carrasco, The Tenochca Empire of Ancient Mexico, University of Oklahoma Press, 1999) — near-unanimous, undisputed date. Fell 1521 at the siege of Tenochtitlan; the fall must be modeled as multi-causal, not a simple "conquistadors won" narrative — see claim_tenochtitlan_fall_multicausal.
